name: prometheus
description: Prometheus personal companion runtime for Windows

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @prometheus/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @prometheus/admin
scripts.test: npm run build:web && npm run test --workspace @prometheus/server
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown apps deploy/prometheus package.json README.md docs/prometheus-*.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown apps deploy/prometheus package.json README.md docs/prometheus-*.md
